lines.t: Who, who, who, who, who
Shadows tremble beneath your name
Echoes awaken the heart of flame
Your servants kneel
Where faith is born through sacred silence
Their souls are torn
Lightning breaks across the night
Still they walk by unseen
Like you are the breath within my pain
The voice that calls me through the rain
When I fall, your mercy flies
In holy fear, my soul will rise
Through the veil I see your face
The upper crown and endless grace
The letter fades
The spirit speaks
Wisdom whispers
To the meek
In patient trust, they will remain
Bound in love, untouched by pain
Mystery burns, yet hearts obey
Waiting for the dawn of day
You are the breath within my pain
The voice that calls me through the rain
When I fall, your mercy flies
In holy fear, my soul will rise
Through the veil, I see your face
The author crowned in endless grace
Every chain begins to break
Faith consumes the doubt it makes
All barriers for the dark undone
Revealed in light, the rising sun
I stand at the edge of time
Time's last breath. Life awakened beyond death. You whisper truth I can't unsee. Eternal peace surrounding me.
May you are the breath within my pain The voice that calls me through the rain
When I fall, your mercy flies In holy fear, my soul will rise
All creation bows in flame Forever singing out your name
The end and beginning, forever the same
The finisher whispers, faith remains
I'll wait in the silence, still and pure
For I am yours
Forever sure
